composition_variation: Create a whimsical refined anime portrait of Beerus relaxing at a small terrace dessert table. Preserve his recognizable purple feline head, long upright ears, gold collar, and elegant Egyptian-inspired blue-and-black fully covering outfit. He sits comfortably in a low chair, paws resting naturally beside a small pudding dish, wearing a quietly pleased expression. Keep the scene entirely peaceful and character-focused. Use plum-purple shadows, warm saffron sunset, pale stone architecture, turquoise textile accents, and expansive softly glowing upper sky. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
